title: Intangible Assets
summary: Prescribes the recognition, measurement and amortisation of intangible assets, including the research/development split, converged almost exactly with IAS 38.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Closely Converged with IAS 38
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 38 reproduces IAS 38's research/development split, recognition criteria, and amortisation model almost exactly, with no substantive divergence. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent for the IT/software and pharmaceutical sectors' R&D capitalisation judgements. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
